audit_items.proof_trace: The fee is correctly computed as `emode.flash_loan().fee_rate().int_mul(amount)` (line 811-813), using the flash_loan_fee_rate from the caller-specified emode_group. Flash loans in this protocol are standalone operations with no associated obligation; the `emode_group: u8` parameter explicitly selects which emode configuration to use. Access is restricted to admin-whitelisted callers with `PackageCallerCap` + `flash_loan` permission, so the emode group selection is trusted by design.
